{
  "test_name": "Case 1: Basic Types",
  "description": "Validate basic JSON types: int, bool, float, string, null",
  "input": {
    "int_field": 42,
    "bool_field": true,
    "float_field": 3.14,
    "string_field": "test_string",
    "null_field": null
  },
  "expected_output": {
    "int_field": 42,
    "bool_field": true,
    "float_field": 3.14,
    "string_field": "test_string",
    "null_field": null
  },
  "validation_strategy": "field_by_field_comparison",
  "type_check": "type(returned_value) == type(original_value)",
  "value_check": "returned_value == original_value"
}
